title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator

author: Saman J Nasur
title: Hiring Character Design Artist – Foundational Team (Paid)
content: [Hiring] Character Design Artist – Foundational Team (Paid) I am reopening the search for a talented Character Design Artist to join my foundational team and help build the aesthetic blueprint of this project from the ground up. This is a dedicated world-building and design phase role. Rather than stepping into a rigid production pipeline, your sole focus will be crafting a cohesive, expressive character identity from scratch. Scope of Work: Character Design: Creating distinct, expressive character concepts, wardrobe, and design sheets. Visual Development: Establishing the foundational look, feel, and personality of the cast to anchor the project's overall aesthetic. What We Offer: Fully paid role. A structured, realistic production timeline focused on deliberate quality. The role has strong potential for long-term growth as the project expands. Art Style Reference: Check out the examples below to get a sense of the mood, tone, and visual direction we are aiming for To Apply: If you have professional experience in character design and want to help shape a new universe, please message me on Facebook first with your email address. From there, send your name, portfolio, and a brief introduction to OriginPointStudio1of1@gmail.com, and I will review everything later today. I'm looking forward to connecting with you!
